mr_title: [Flight] Add more DoS mitigations to Flight Reply, and harden Flight
thesis: Hardens Flight replies against oversized server-function payloads.

slides.title: Flight Reply DoS Hardening
slides.subtitle: Server Functions reject oversized replies before parsing spirals
bullets: [fix] caps ==nested reply expansion== across Flight decoding

bullets.why: One missed wrapper keeps custom arraySizeLimit unreachable for that runtime.

slides.title: Threat Model
slides.caption: Untrusted replies can multiply work before user code runs.
bullets: untrusted FormData can multiply references and arrays
limits attach to the shared Reply decoder
repeated wrappers pass the same option shape

slides.title: Nested Arrays Spend Budget
slides.caption: Counts forked arrays before recursive revive walks children.

callouts.why: Without early counting, attacker-shaped nested arrays can force deep traversal first.

slides.title: The Budget Gate
slides.caption: One helper enforces array and scalar growth caps.

callouts.why: Single long lists still work; multiplicative nesting is what fails fast.

slides.title: Server References Share Promise
slides.caption: Duplicate metadata waits on the first resolver.

callouts.line_text: const blockedPromise: BlockedChunk<T> = new ReactPromise(BLOCKED, null, null);

slides.title: Bound Args Have a Ceiling
slides.caption: Bound server functions reject huge argument lists.

callouts.why: Huge bound arrays no longer allocate into Function.bind first.

slides.title: Duplicate Actions Load Once
slides.caption: Repeated action fields are ignored after first sighting.

slides.title: Client Refuses Prototype Writes
slides.caption: Reference resolution validates paths before assigning values.

callouts.why: Prototype-chain lookups could resolve attacker-controlled references.

slides.title: Client Upload Dedupes Functions
slides.caption: Outgoing references reuse FormData IDs and warn on proto.

slides.title: Review Risks
slides.caption: Three risks span files, not one hunk.

bullets.why: A missed entrypoint would ignore caller-provided arraySizeLimit in that bundler/runtime pair.

bullets.text: [risk] MAX defaults are policy, not tests
bullets.why: Limits might block exotic valid payloads; check React's downstream release notes.
Non-plain metadata objects or frozen payloads could break dedupe assumptions.

slides.title: Not in the deck
slides.caption: Skim these in the platform UI

bullets.why: Dedupe depends on mutating parsed metadata; frozen or exotic values could reject unexpectedly.
